name: David Rivera
source:
Likes: Rugby, cats, silence
Dislikes: Crowded and noisy places

Usually cheerful and optimistic, but currently feeling down. Physically strong, but mentally still a bit naive. Easygoing and extroverted, well-liked by people. Used to play team sports in high school.

He works in a gym as a personal trainer and instructor. Addicted to coffee.
